main_text.p: ri. Constantius Imperator Arianis impel-lentibus Gregorium quemdam Cappado-cem, alij Georgium vocant, Arianum hæ-resi, recusante id onus Eufebio, delegit, neque ex primiore vita, vt idem Athanasius tradit, commendatum, nec vllo modo Chri-stianum, sed pro temporis conditione no-men Christi assumentem, & olim pro im-pietate sua excommunicatum Patriarcham Alexandrinum anno 341. siue 342. creat, qui vsus ministerio Philagrij, & Arsacij ma-gistratuum Alexandrinam Ecclesiam inua-dit. Post interemptum Gregorium an-no 362. Georgius identidem Arianus ijsdem promotoribus, & fautoribus in eundem Pa-triarchatum immittitur anno 356. & anno 362. dire necatur a Gentilibus, cum non solum Catholicorum, sed Gentilium Ale-xandrinorum infensissimum odium incur-risset. Nec defuerunt Ariani, qui eum sic a Gentilibus cæsum, vt martyrem coluerint, teste Epiphanio, qui eum indignum esse no-mine Martyris pronunciauit, quod non ob Christi fidem, sed ob nefanda commissa scelera dignas pœnas persoluerit. De suc-cessione horum Patriarcharum Athanasius, ἀπέσ[?]ειλε ὁ μὲν πρῶτον Γρηγόριον, καὶ νῦν τὸν ταμιευόμενον[?] Γεώργιον. Misit primum quidem Gregorium, & nunc receptorem tributorum, Geor-

page.notes: The Greek line is set in italic. Its letters are only partly legible at this scan resolution, so the Greek words marked [?] are uncertain. The printed "Mifit" is read as "Misit" with long s. The final "Geor-" is a line-end hyphen, not a catchword, so the text is kept whole to the last line. The page opens mid-sentence and continues from the previous page.
